verdict.rationale: Gide's own Global page says it supports international clients 'through our 11 offices' and names them: Algiers, Brussels, Casablanca, Dakar, Istanbul, London, New York, Paris, Shanghai, Tunis and Warsaw. It also says it has been established in New York for 40 years and London for 20, so a founder expanding can stay with the same firm in many markets. Missing for 10: detail on which local-law practices or qualifications each office offers, and independent corroboration of the office network beyond the firm's own site.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm

citations.quote: Our firm operates with a global reach, enabling us to support our international client base through our 11 offices
established in New York for 40 years and in London for 20 years
We provide assistance with acquisitions, sales and transfers in France and internationally.
